consequences: Hash-protected deliverables make sati read file bytes in a general project. This narrows the Phase 8 rule "sati never opens your files" to: sati never reads file contents into its memory; it may hash a file the owner marked as approved.
context: PLAN Phase 9 listed four items as needing the owner's decision. Phase 7d listed the launcher and inbox under "needs Phase 6", but both work on one machine.
decision: On 2026-11-11 the owner chose to build now: card keys for outside files and links, the `sati app` launcher (unsigned), the in-app inbox, a folder-sync mode without git (ADR first), and hash-protected deliverables. Phase 6 (hosted mode) stays deferred until v1.0 is published and tried.
title: Owner approves the Phase 9 decision items; Phase 6 stays deferred
